writing.exampleCaption: One is a stream with no message boundaries; the other is not.
writing.explanation: TCP costs a handshake, retransmission, and head-of-line blocking in exchange for delivery and order. UDP hands you a message that may vanish, arrive twice, or arrive out of order, and leaves reliability to you — which is exactly why QUIC and real-time media build their own on top of it. The right answer names the trade-off rather than declaring one better.
writing.feedback: Retransmitting audio that is already too late only adds delay.
